runtime.description: The Conflux gathers the elemental planes into one army: pixies, air, water, fire, and earth elementals, psychic and magic elementals, and phoenixes. Elementalists shape battle through raw magic, planar summons, and forces that do not fight like mortal troops.

allowedDebt: Greenlands is the current release custom biome for Conflux. Exact HoMM3/HotA Highlands fidelity remains terrain presentation debt, but it must not block Core exposure.
Conflux elementals share donors with existing custom factions. Reverse lookup must stay context-required, especially for hydra and Nature donor rows.

Elemental immunities, vulnerabilities, morale rules, spellcasting, and remaining town/build-tree polish are release hardening debt. Keep the debt explicit; do not hide Conflux from DB/data.json as a crash workaround.
